t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes will appear in fixed pairs of colours, but positions may vary. Each gnome takes you to a forest, either dark or light with different coloured baskets. Goal is to consistently go to forest with most mushrooms but amount of mushrooms differs each time. Gnomes size, hat and position matter

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will appear in a pair of colours, this won't change but the position of them will.When you choose a gnome it will take you to a forest with a red or yellow basket, this changes all the time and I personally found no pattern.Try to remember which of the two gnomes from the pairs gives you the most mushrooms, this can change so change your thoughts accordingly. E.g. you should have 4 colours in your head to know what to click.I don't actually know if any of this matters but this is what I did to try to get the most mushrooms.
